subject.title: fix: restore grouped AI auth options in guided onboarding

question: Should guided onboarding gain the new pre-inference “Skip for now” exit as part of this bug-fix PR?
rationale: The grouped picker and bounded probe identifier repair demonstrated failures, while the skip exit reverses an explicitly documented onboarding policy and is not required for either fix.

options.title: Separate the skip behavior
options.body: Remove the skip exit from this PR, land the two demonstrated fixes, and consider the onboarding-policy change independently.

options.title: Approve the combined behavior
options.body: Keep the skip exit, explicitly accept the guided-flow policy change, and validate the complete rebased flow before merge.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold landing if maintainers want guided onboarding redesigned more broadly rather than changing this single exit point.

recommendation.title: Separate the skip behavior
recommendation.body: Remove the skip exit from this PR, land the two demonstrated fixes, and consider the onboarding-policy change independently.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the self-assigned repository member currently carrying the guided-onboarding implementation and its proof.
